subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-prefix path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths by default, or add an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current code intentionally shortens home paths, the prior env-var PR closed unmerged, and changing default path display or adding a knob affects product UX and config-surface policy.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve the current compact home-prefix display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Update shared display helpers and prompt guidance so agent-visible file paths under home render as full absolute paths by default.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Add a documented setting or env var for users who want full absolute paths while keeping existing compact defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current compact home-prefix display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: The central path-display helper history points to steipete, and this decision is about the shared display policy he introduced.
